A personal work-management app with AI: tasks in lists, sections / Kanban and tags; month / week calendar; habits; Pomodoro focus; goals & stats; a daily AI schedule and an AI Coach with long-term memory. Works offline and syncs across devices.

• Not getting notifications? Allow notifications and set a due date on the task.
• Add a new list? Right in the Lists section above, under Me → Lists, or in the task detail screen.
• Split work into stages? Open a list → add sections → drag cards between the Kanban columns.
• AI misunderstood a quick add? Describe the time/priority more clearly, then adjust before saving.
